players.bio: Alejo Gastón Montero (born 5 May 1998) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Newell's Old Boys. Career Montero started his career with Vélez Sarsfield, having joined them in February 2009.
Brian Calderara (born 10th January 1998) is an Argentine footballer who plays as a Left-Back for Newell's Old Boys.
Bruno Leonel Cabrera (born 28 April 1997) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Chilean club Coquimbo Unido.
CA Newell's Old Boys 2
Fabricio Tirado (born 18th September 2004) is an Argentine footballer who plays as a midfielder for Newell's Old Boys.
Frank Darío Kudelka (born 12 May 1961) is an Argentine football manager, currently in charge of Newell's Old Boys.

Gabriel Arias Arroyo (born 13 September 1987) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Argentine Primera División club Racing Club. Born in Argentina, he plays for the Chile national team.

Ian Glavinovich (born 27 October 2001) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a central defender for Argentina Primera Division club Newell's Old Boys. He is an Argentina U23 international.

Juan Ignacio Ramírez Polero (born 1 February 1997) is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as a forward for Chilean club Everton on loan from Argentine Primera División club Newell's Old Boys.

Jeronimo Russo (born 30 May 2005) is an Argentine footballer who plays as a forward for Newell's Old Boys. Jherson Steven Mosquera Castro (born 18 September 1999 in Pereira) is a Colombian footballer who plays as a midfielder. He plays as a right-back and his current team is Newell's Old Boys of the Argentine First Division. Career Promoted to Deportivo Pereira's first team in 2018, Mosquera established himself in the starting team in the 2021 season.
Lautaro Daniel Giannetti (born 13 November 1993) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Turkish Süper Lig club Antalyaspor.

Leonel Jesús Vangioni Rangel (born 5 May 1987) is an Argentine footballer who plays as a left-back for Newell's Old Boys in the Argentine Primera División. He has represented the Argentina national team.
Luciano Lollo (born March 29, 1987, in Alejo Ledesma, Argentina) is an Argentine footballer who plays for Estudiantes in the Argentine Primera División as a centre-back.

Martín Abel Luciano (born 12 August 2003) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Newell's Old Boys. Career Having started his football as a 5 years old at Club Atlético Provincial in Rosario, Santa Fe, Martín Luciano joined Newell's Old Boys in 2016.

Matías Fernando Cóccaro Ferreira (born 15 November 1997) is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as a striker for Liga MX club Atlas, on loan from CF Montréal. Career In 2017, Cóccaro joined the youth academy of Italian Serie A side Cagliari.
José Mauricio Larriera Dibarboure (born 26 August 1970) is a Uruguayan football manager and former player who played as a right-back. He is the current manager of Argentine club Newell's Old Boys.
Misael Jaime (born 13th January 2004) is an Argentine footballer who plays as a Midfielder for Newell's Old Boys.

Oscar Camilo Salomón (born 22 March 1999) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Platense, on loan from Boca Juniors. Club career Salomón's youth career started with Centro De Educación Física Nº18, with whom he notably won the Gothia Cup with; which was followed by a move to Boca Juniors in 2012.

Rodrigo Ezequiel Herrera (born 2 August 2000) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Platense, on loan from Defensa y Justicia. Career Herrera is a product of the Defensa y Justicia youth system.

Saúl Salcedo Zárate (born 29 August 1997) is a Paraguayan footballer who plays for Club Olimpia and the Paraguay national team. He was summoned for Paraguay national under-20 football team to play 2015 South American Youth Football Championship. Salcedo was named in Paraguay's provisional squad for Copa América Centenario but was cut from the final squad.

Valentino Andrés Acuña (born 27 January 2006) is an Argentine footballer currently playing as a midfielder for Newell's Old Boys. Club career Born in Rosario in the Santa Fe Province of Argentina, Acuña began his footballing career at the age of three with local side Bancaria.
Walter Uriel Mazzantti (born 5 September 1996) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays for Independiente.
